diagnosis.summary: The nightly run c0c56e34 for 2026-10-01 failed at ingest because upstream never delivered landing/orders/dt=2026-10-01/orders.csv. The customers, order_items and payments files for that day all arrived complete and match the contract, so this looks like a one-off export glitch for orders only. I've proposed asking upstream to re-export orders, order_items and payments for 2026-10-01 and then rerunning the partition.

root_cause.explanation: The upstream export did not write orders.csv for dt=2026-10-01. The partition directory exists and the other three tables for that day were delivered and parse cleanly, so the orders export failed on its own. Nothing points to a schema, model or environment problem. The previous two runs succeeded.

evidence.claim: Run c0c56e34 failed at the ingest step because the orders landing file was missing; the previous runs succeeded
No orders.csv exists for dt=2026-10-01, although the partition directory exists
The other tables for 2026-10-01 were delivered, are well-formed and match the contract, so the export ran and only orders is missing
The runbook says a missing landing file is fixed by redelivering the related order tables

alternatives_considered: rerun_only: rejected because nothing shows the file has arrived since, and a rerun would fail the same way
Empty or partial file: ruled out because no file exists at all
Persistent upstream change or schema change: unlikely because the other tables match the contract and the prior day ran fine. If the redelivery also lacks orders, escalate to upstream_app_team
Redelivering orders only: rejected because policy says to redeliver all the related order tables (orders, order_items, payments) so they stay consistent

proposal.rationale: The orders landing file for 2026-10-01 was never delivered, but the partition directory exists and the customers, order_items and payments files for that day are present, well-formed and match the contract. That points to a one-off export glitch for orders, not a deliberate upstream change. The runbook says to request redelivery of the related order tables (orders, order_items, payments) together so they stay consistent, then rerun.

applied: upstream re-exported orders (440 rows), order_items (840 rows), payments (417 rows) for 2026-10-01
